user.title: BTicino MyHome - MH201
user.description: Configure the local OpenWebNet connection to the MH201 gateway.

data_description.host: Local network address of the MH201 gateway.
data_description.port: TCP port used by the local OpenWebNet server.
data_description.password: Leave blank only when the gateway does not require an OpenWebNet password.

confirm.title: Discovered {model}
confirm.description: Home Assistant discovered a BTicino {model} gateway at {host}. Confirm the OpenWebNet connection settings.

data_description.port: TCP port used by the discovered gateway's local OpenWebNet server.
data_description.password: Leave blank only when the gateway does not require an OpenWebNet password.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate BTicino MyHome
reauth_confirm.description: The MH201 gateway at {host} rejected the stored credentials. Enter the current OpenWebNet password.

data_description.password: Current password accepted by the local OpenWebNet gateway.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure BTicino MyHome
reconfigure.description: Update the network connection for this MH201 gateway. Stable serial/UDN identity is checked when discovery data is available.

data_description.host: New local network address for the same MH201 gateway.
data_description.port: TCP port used by the local OpenWebNet server.
data_description.password: Leave blank to keep the currently stored password.
data_description.clear_password: Enable this only when the gateway no longer requires authentication. It takes precedence over the password field.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the gateway. Check address and port.
error.invalid_auth: The gateway rejected the OpenWebNet credentials.
error.wrong_gateway: The discovered serial/UDN does not match this configured gateway.
error.already_configured: Another configuration entry already uses this gateway identity.

abort.cannot_connect: The discovered gateway does not provide a usable network address.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The gateway configuration was updated successfully.

data.include_scenarios: Include scenario events observed during the scan

data_description.action: Choose whether to scan, passively learn, manually add or remove endpoints.
data_description.include_scenarios: Keep scenario endpoints observed while the active discovery window is running.
data_description.discovery_listen_seconds: Additional event-listening window after conservative active probes complete.

passive_learning.title: Learn BTicino devices
passive_learning.description: Listen to the BUS without sending commands. Use the physical controls you want to identify while listening.

data_description.listen_seconds: How long to listen for OpenWebNet events without actively probing the BUS.

select_learned.title: Discovered devices
select_learned.description: Select the devices to add to the inventory.

data_description.devices: Only selected endpoints are persisted in this gateway inventory.

manual_device.title: Add device manually
manual_device.description: Register an OpenWebNet endpoint by WHO and WHERE.

data_description.who: OpenWebNet function family number, for example 2 for automation or 4 for thermoregulation.
data_description.where: OpenWebNet endpoint address exactly as used by the installation.
data_description.device_type: Home Assistant surface to associate with this supported WHO family.
data_description.advanced_shutter: Enable only for a WHO=2 advanced motor actuator that provides OpenWebNet DIM=10 position/status and DIM=11 GoToLevel.
data_description.climate_profile: For WHO=4 climate endpoints, explicitly restrict the zone to heating, cooling, or both. Leave unset when not known.
data_description.name: Optional endpoint name shown in Home Assistant.

remove_device.title: Remove configured devices
remove_device.description: Select inventory endpoints to remove. Their Home Assistant entities and endpoint device entries are removed as well.

data_description.devices: Removal is explicit; missing discovery responses never remove devices automatically.

error.invalid_device: The selected device type, thermal profile or advanced-shutter option is not valid for the specified WHO.

abort.no_devices_found: No supported device was detected during listening.
abort.no_devices_configured: There are no configured endpoints to remove.
abort.cannot_connect: The integration is not currently loaded or the gateway connection failed.

send_frame.name: Send OpenWebNet frame
send_frame.description: Advanced/debug action that sends one raw OpenWebNet frame through a specific configured MH201 gateway.

config_entry_id.name: Gateway
config_entry_id.description: BTicino MyHome configuration entry that owns the target MH201 connection.

frame.name: Frame
frame.description: Raw OpenWebNet frame to send, for example *1*1*21##.

is_status_request.name: Status request
is_status_request.description: Enable only when the raw frame is a status request whose returned data frames should be normalized as state evidence.

arm_alarm_partitions.name: Arm alarm partitions
arm_alarm_partitions.description: Arm the WHO=5 alarm using the selected active-partition mask. The legacy BTicino command is reference-backed but still requires validation on the target 4200C through MH201.

config_entry_id.name: Gateway
config_entry_id.description: BTicino MyHome configuration entry that owns the target MH201 connection.

partitions.name: Active partitions
partitions.description: Partitions 1-8 that must remain active; unselected partitions are partialized.

set_alarm_partition.name: Set alarm partition
set_alarm_partition.description: Activate or partialize one WHO=5 partition. The command is specification/reference-backed but still requires validation on the target 4200C through MH201.

config_entry_id.name: Gateway
config_entry_id.description: BTicino MyHome configuration entry that owns the target MH201 connection.

active.name: Active
active.description: Enable to make the partition active; disable to partialize it.

send_frame_entry_not_found.message: The selected BTicino MyHome configuration entry was not found.

send_frame_entry_not_loaded.message: The selected BTicino MyHome gateway is not currently loaded.

send_frame_failed.message: Failed to send the OpenWebNet frame: {detail}

cover_position_not_supported.message: Position control is not enabled for this MyHOME shutter.

cover_position_out_of_range.message: Shutter position {position}% is outside the supported 0–100% range.

unsupported_hvac_mode.message: HVAC mode {hvac_mode} is not supported by this MyHOME thermoregulation zone.

unsupported_preset_mode.message: Preset {preset_mode} is not supported by this MyHOME thermoregulation zone.

temperature_out_of_range.message: Temperature {temperature} °C is outside the supported range {min_temp}–{max_temp} °C.
